title: Chef Food Tour of Seattle Space Needle and Seattle Center
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Please message us before the tour date if you have any dietary considerations.
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Please arrive 10 minutes early to the meeting point to check in
In the event of a non-appearance for any reason, we regret to inform you that rescheduling or refunding will not be feasible.
Meeting location is Dog in the Park, 400 Broad St (The location under the Space Needle)
This experience DOES NOT include a visit to the Space Needle- we provide a food tour in the Seattle Center neighborhood
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Space Needle Food Tour is the only chef-guided experience that blends Seattle’s culture, history, and flavor in the heart of the city’s most iconic neighborhood. You’ll visit 5 food stops and enjoy 2 beverages, with carefully selected bites that highlight the best of the Pacific Northwest. Along the way, you’ll support small, local food businesses and learn from a chef who brings the area’s food and stories to life. * Please this tour DOES NOT go up in the Space Needle. It is is a food tour in the surrounding area
